g.text: Portland to the Strait of Dover, with the coast of Normandy
Horizontal datum: WGS 84 · Depths and drying heights in metres below chart datum (approximately Lowest Astronomical Tide) · Heights in metres
Magnetic variation from the WMM2025 for 2026: see the compass roses
This chart is a teaching aid for the Yachtmaster Academy course and must not be used for navigation. It is not an official nautical chart and is not kept up to date by Notices to Mariners.

Dangers: only wrecks and obstructions with 10 m or less over them, those that dry or show, and those of unknown depth in 20 m or less, are charted. Wrecks that lie close together are shown as areas marked Wks or Obstns.
Drawn by Offshore Theory for training use. Not for navigation.

Wrecks and obstructions: Contains public sector information, licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0, from the UK Hydrographic Office. The data sets are not suitable for use in marine navigation or in the creation of
Traffic separation schemes: Shom, 2021, Dispositifs de séparation du trafic, Licence Ouverte 2.0 — Ne pas utiliser pour la navigation. UK Hydrographic Office, Open Government Licence v3.0.
Lights and buoys checked against: Shom, 2026, https://dx.doi.org/10.17183/DOI_BALISAGE_MARITIME, Licence Ouverte 2.0; List of Lights, Pub. 114, National Geospatial-Intelligence Agency.
Nature of the seabed: Seabed substrates, EMODnet Geology, CC-BY 4.0, Includes SHOM (2010) G maps numerical product.
Magnetic variation: World Magnetic Model 2025, NOAA/NCEI and British Geological Survey, public domain.
